facts.fact: Ecofin says the technical and vocational education strategy aligns with the Strategic Digital Plan (PSN 2023-2028), launched by the Ministry of Digital Development, Digital Transformation, Posts and Telecommunications; no act of adoption and no launch date is stated, so the article's 23 September 2025 publication date is used.

systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Development, Digital Transformation, Posts and Telecommunications
systems.tiers: described only as addressing the ICT skills deficit

systems.system: national digitalization strategy of the technical and vocational education sector
systems.country_label: stratégie nationale de digitalisation du secteur
systems.owner: Ministry of Technical Education and Vocational Training, UNESCO-backed
systems.tiers: adopted at a ceremony in the week before 23 September 2025; 22 priority projects, 40,000 people trained in digital skills by 2028

note: PSN fact recorded with class empty: the article states the launch but does not describe the plan's scope. The sector strategy is a ministry plan.
